nodes.label: armarCatalogo_()
nodes.rationale: Computes ocupados in code instead of relying on sheet formulas.

nodes.label: CFG
nodes.rationale: Sheet names, states that count against cupo (Pre-registro, Inscrito), 60s cache key.

nodes.label: doPost()
nodes.rationale: Script lock serializes pre-registros so the last seat is not sold twice; dedupes by phone+apertura; started or full apertura becomes Lista de espera redirected to next apertura.

nodes.label: leerTabla_()
nodes.rationale: Columns looked up by header name (with short alias stripping parentheses) so columns can move without breaking.

nodes.label: Codigo.gs (Apps Script backend)
nodes.rationale: Backend pasted into the 'Landing Talleres 2026-2027' sheet; reads tabs Talleres, Aperturas, Inscripciones, Documentos, Configuración.

nodes.label: Pre-registro / waitlist form dialog (#modal)
nodes.rationale: Collects nombre, teléfono, and alumno/edad for children's talleres; privacy checkbox required.

nodes.label: Lista de espera
nodes.rationale: If taller started or full, person gets priority for next apertura.

nodes.label: Live Server (VS Code extension)
nodes.rationale: Needed for offline mode; opening index.html by double-click disables it.

nodes.label: Pre-registro
nodes.rationale: Name and phone only; reserves the seat; enrollment finishes in person.

nodes.label: Aviso de privacidad (provisional)
nodes.rationale: Provisional text; official notice from the center still missing.

nodes.label: Rule: no entry to started or full taller (waitlist)
nodes.norm_label: rule: no entry to started or full taller (waitlist)

nodes.label: doGet()
nodes.rationale: Serves cached catalog JSON; never sends names or phones.

nodes.label: URL_API
nodes.rationale: Apps Script /exec URL placed in app.js switches data from datos.js to Google Sheets; datos.js already matches the JSON shape.

nodes.label: Fixed 'today' date (30-oct-2026)
nodes.rationale: Fixed so example states render well; real version uses new Date().
